messages:
Rhea (CS): quick sync — SolaceMed asked for a one-page SLO summary + example credit calc before go-live. They want clarity on uptime, p95 latency per endpoint, and how credits trigger.
Liam (CS Ops): ok. do we have their expected traffic distribution? embeddings vs text-gen? that'll change p95 baselines.
Claire (Acct): they send large embedding batches at 23:00-01:00 ET and steady chat during APAC mornings. i'll attach their onboarding traffic sample after this thread.
Diego (SRE): plan: pull 30d rolling metrics from prod tags (customer:solacemed). for p95: Datadog query per-service:
```
avg(last_30d):p95:http.request.duration{env:prod,customer:solacemed,service:embedding} by {region}
```
and for text-gen:
```
avg(last_30d):p95:http.request.duration{env:prod,customer:solacemed,service:text-gen} by {region}
```
Rhea (CS): thank you. what's our recommended SLO set for this profile?
Liam (CS Ops): propose: uptime SLO = 99.95% monthly; embeddings p95 <= 300ms; text-gen p95 <= 450ms. different thresholds because of model size and batching.
Claire (Acct): 99.95 is fine if we document scheduled maintenance and CDN variance. legal wants the credit calc clear.
Diego (SRE): operational caveats: we exclude scheduled maint announced >= 48h in advance. latency measured at Redwood edge; client network/VPN added latency not counted. Also mention cold-starts for very large models may affect p95 for rare requests.
Liam (CS Ops): i'll include a short "how we measure" box: sampling frequency (1s), histogram buckets, how p95 is computed across endpoints, and how aggregated region p95 is computed (weighted by requests).
Rhea (CS): draft the customer-facing blurb: "Redwood measures uptime and p95 latency from our edge; credits apply per contract if monthly uptime falls below the SLO. Scheduled maintenance announced >= 48 hours in advance is excluded."
Claire (Acct): good. Legal suggested an explicit example. can we add numbers?
Liam (CS Ops): sample credit calc row for the packet (assume monthly committed fee = $12,000):
- SLO: 99.95% uptime target
- Observed uptime (30d): 99.70%
- Shortfall = 0.25 percentage points -> relative shortfall = 0.25 / 99.95 = 0.002500... (~0.25%)
- Credit = 0.25% of monthly committed fee = $30.00
I'll format that as a tiny table in the packet.
Diego (SRE): small nit: show both absolute pp shortfall and relative percent so it's transparent. also attach the dashboards and raw query strings so customer can reproduce.
ops-bot: Ticket created: CS-7042 "SolaceMed SLO one-pager + credit example" assigned to CS Ops, SRE, and Accounts.
Rhea (CS): timeline: can Liam and Diego drop the metrics + example by Thursday EOD? I'll draft the customer slide and one-paragraph exec summary.
Liam (CS Ops): yes, ill have the table and the reproducible queries by Thu EOD.
Diego (SRE): ill export dashboards and include a short runbook fragment showing the Datadog query and how to filter by request tags.
Claire (Acct): once we have the packet i'll prep the renewal/contract note explaining credit flow and invoice application.
Rhea (CS): great. i'll post the draft packet link here when ready and schedule a 30-min review with SolaceMed. Thanks all.
